description: This Java class implements in-memory management for TodoItems, providing methods for adding, updating, and retrieving to-do items with thread-safe handling. It is a component of a demo web application built with JSF/PrimeFaces on Tomcat.

classes.name: TodoItemManagementInMemory
classes.description: Java class managing TodoItem objects in memory with thread safety.

methods.name: getTodoItems
methods.description: Returns the thread-safe list of TodoItems.

methods.name: setTodoItems
methods.description: Sets the internal TodoItems list with null safety.

methods.name: addTodoItem
methods.description: Adds a TodoItem to the list, assigning a new ID based on the last item's ID.

methods.name: updateTodoItem
methods.description: Updates existing TodoItems by ID, marking them as complete, or adds them if not found.

methods.name: findIndexByIdLocked
methods.description: Finds index of a TodoItem by ID using linear search; must be called within synchronized block.
